skills.name: BWAAH, HA, HA
skills.description: Gets a belly laugh. Good effects on allies.  *Skill Evade Rate +40% (10 sec) *Skill Resistance +40% (10 sec)

skills.name: Octashredder
skills.description: Jumps up high, opens up his umbrella, and floats in the air. Drops straight down at enemies after closing the umbrella.  *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *Bunches enemies up  *Stuns enemies (6 sec) *ATK x 4400% Area Damage

abilities.name: Group: GACHIAKUTA
abilities.description: GACHIAKUTA Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deploy Stun: Intelligence
abilities.description: Has a high chance of stunning all Intelligence type enemies and canceling their invincibility skill effects when Rangers deploy. - Activates 5 seconds after battles start. - You must wait 6 seconds before you can use an Ability again after using one with the same effect on the same type of Ranger. - Bosses, Guardians, and special type enemies are not affected by this Ability.
